newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha softens with crude, only muted interes.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha softens with crude, only muted interes.

text.p: Naphtha was $2 or so weaker on Friday tracking crude's southwards pull and reflecting muted European demand.
Physical activity was quiet, but January was done at $220, February at $216 and March at $213 cif NWE.
High paraffinic was eliciting more interest than full range and N+A and was attracting numbers close to quotes high +$4-4.50.
"The premium for good quality stuff looks to be holding," said one trader.
Full range and N+A was still very much in the doldrums.
The main petchem buyers continue to look relaxed and the bits and pieces of trade that occured this week have largely been trader to trader.
Most end-users appeared to have stocked up with material before Christmas, but some may have to come into the market towards the end of next week.
